name: Carbon & Cashmere
description: Crypto trading intelligence API with 177 x402-paid endpoints across 7 networks (Base, Polygon, Arbitrum, World Chain, Solana, Algorand, Stellar). MCP server @carbon-cashmere/x402-mcp published on Anthropic MCP Registry, Smithery, Glama, and npm.
